extracted.intended_audience: dealers, wholesalers, builders, and contractors ordering doors, frames, mouldings, stair parts, and related millwork
extracted.subtask_description: Dealer price list / product specification catalog for doors, frames, mouldings, stairwork, porch rail, columns, and related millwork items, including dimensions, material notes, packaging and pricing modifiers. Used to specify orders and compute dealer pricing and extras.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sticking style (profile)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies the sticking/profile used on door and French door designs (e.g., 'Bead and Cove Sticking', 'Bead and Cove or Sash Sticking', 'Cove and Bead Sticking', 'Gove and Bead Sticking', 'Plain Raised Mould One Side, Flush Mould One Side'). Some designs note 'Our Option' to indicate optional profile choices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profile is listed per design and may be offered as an option ('Our Option'). Different sticking options correspond to distinct design numbers and associated prices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stiles, top rail, bottom rail, cross rail dimensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Designs list precise rail and stile dimensions per model (examples: 'Stiles and Top Rail 5J^" Bottom Rail 9%"', 'Stiles 5 Top Rail 6 H" Bottom Rail 18^"', 'Stiles and Top Rail 4%" Bottom Rail 9J/4"', 'Stiles and Top Rail 6 \ Bottom Rail 16', 'Lock Rail 7" exclusive of moulding').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dimensions vary by design number and affect price. Some items marked with special symbols (★) have additional dimensional variations and specific add-on charges for alternate widths (example: 'Items marked ★ with Stiles and Top Rail — (Add for 1 1/8" $0.31 ... )').

rubrics_metrics.name: Glass opening dimensions and glass-height rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Each design provides glass opening dimensions for a reference door (e.g., 'Glass Opening for 2-8x6-8 Door 22x18 or 20', 'Glass Size for 2-8x6-8 Door 22x56', 'Glass Opening 15^x66%'). Several entries note 'All Sizes Have Glass Opening 18" or 20" High Our Option' or list specific glass sizes for different stock sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Glass opening size is specified per design and per reference door size (often 2-8x6-8). This drives the glazed pricing and which glazed plate add-on applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stock sizes and price classes
rubrics_metrics.description: For each design, a table of stock (standard) sizes is given with price columns labeled 'Open', 'Gla. S. S. B.', 'Gla. D. S. B.' (and variants). Stock sizes include entries like '2-8x6-8', '2-10x6-10', '3-0x6-8', '7-0', etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the stock size row to determine the base price for a given design and whether the door is 'open' (no glass) or glazed (various glazed classifications). Abbreviations are used throughout; the price varies by size and glazing classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glazed plate add-on pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Many designs specify: 'Glazed Bevel Plate Add to open door price $X' or 'Glazed Plain Plate Add to open door price $X' with amounts varying by design (examples in the text: $8.66, $28.74, $22.64, $26.14, $14.86, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Glazed plate (bevel/plain) is a priced add-on to the open-door base price. The add-on amount is listed per design line or section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering and pricing modifiers / surcharges
rubrics_metrics.description: General order/pricing rules appear repeatedly: 'For Specified Lengths Add 10%'; 'Specified lengths 10% Extra'; 'For less than Crate Lots add 10% Extra'; 'For orders less than 200 feet of any Moulding, add 10%'; 'For Hardwood Mouldings, 1% and 1 1/2" thick, add 25%'; 'Hardwood mouldings finishing wider than 3 1/2" and up to 5 1/2" add 20%'; 'Hardwood mouldings finishing 5 1/2" and 7 1/2" wide add 30%'; 'Add $3.00 each set-up'; 'Bits for special designs, $3.00 per inch.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply these percentage surcharges or flat fees where applicable (specified lengths, small-quantity orders, extra finishing/ripping, set-up charges, special bits). These rules affect final dealer prices beyond the base table values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packing, minimum quantities and packing-related charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Packaging and minimum pack-quantities are specified (examples: 'Packed One Newel in a Carton.'; 'Packed 25 Balusters 1 1/8" to a Crate.'; 'Packed 50 Balusters 1 1/2" to a Crate.'; 'Packed 250 Pieces in a Bundle.'). Also: 'For less than Crate Lots add 10% Extra.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prices in catalog assume standard packing quantities; orders below crate/bundle quantities incur a surcharge (typically 10%). Packing instructions indicate how items are shipped and priced for dealer orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Frame construction options and frame pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Frames are offered 'Knock Down' (KD) or 'Built'. Examples: 'Above Prices are for Frames Knock Down. Frames Built Add $2.00 per Frame.' 'Frames Built Add $1.00 per Frame' for some items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose KD vs built to determine whether to add the stated per-frame build charge. Many frame prices in the tables explicitly state they are KD and list the extra to be added for fully built frames.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material / species notes and price adjustments
rubrics_metrics.description: Material and species notes affecting price: 'All Parts Clear Pine.'; 'All Exposed Parts Clear Pine.'; 'If Unselected Birch, Deduct $1.85.'; 'Mantels Made Yellow Pine Throughout Add.'; individual lines mention 'Oak', 'Birch', 'Yellow Pine', 'Clear Fir', 'Redwood', 'Cypress', 'Gum', etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material selection influences base price and may produce automatic deductions or add-ons. Where 'unselected' species are used there are explicit deductions; where special wood types are requested, prices differ by species.

rubrics_metrics.name: NU-STYLE frame feature requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: NU-STYLE frames list incorporated construction/spec features: 'Outside Casings — 1/4" thick.'; 'Single Sill — thick dadoed for pulley stiles.'; 'Joints primed with Aluminum paint.'; 'Pockets broken out and screwed in.'; 'Blind stops and parting stops nailed in place.'; 'Head casing plowed to receive tongue on side casings.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are required/standard features for NU-STYLE frames; they describe the construction quality and finishing included in the catalog price for NU-STYLE items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transom and transom-height charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Several frame entries specify additional charges for transoms: e.g., 'WITH OAK SILL: For Transom Up to 12" High $+X'; 'For Transom not more than 12" high add $2.24 per frame.' 'For Transom not more than 12" high add $2.28 per Frame.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a transom (up to the stated height) is requested the catalog prescribes a per-frame add-on amount; amounts vary by frame type and wall thickness (e.g., brick wall vs frame house).

rubrics_metrics.name: Moulding pricing rules by wood, size, finishing and extras
rubrics_metrics.description: Mouldings are priced per 100 lineal feet and differentiated by species (Pine, Yellow Pine, Oak, Birch, Gum, etc.) and by profile/size (crown, cove, bed, scotia, quarter round, etc.). Rules include surcharges for cutting to specified lengths, extra for ripping, add percentages for thicker/wider hardwood mouldings, and extra set-up and bits charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select appropriate design number/size/species to find base per-100-ft price; then apply the listed surcharges for specified lengths (+10%), small orders (+10%), ripping (flat or % as listed), finishing wider sizes (+20% or +30%), and set-up fees ($3.00 each) where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sash-stock and check-rail pricing conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: SASH STOCK PINE pricing: 'Per 100 Lineal Feet Stile and Top Rail I 3/8 x 2 1/4" (Western Opening) $8.40; ... Stile and Top Rail 1 5/8 x 2 3/4" (Ohio Opening) $12.56; Bottom Rails and muntins listed with per-100-ft prices.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sash stock and check-rail prices are given per 100 lineal feet and vary by opening style (Western vs Ohio) and rail dimensions. Apply general 'specified lengths +10%' rule when length is not standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pulley, hardware, lot pricing and freight rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes on pulleys and hardware: 'Pulleys Included But Not Attached.'; pulley lot pricing (case lot vs less-than-case lot prices listed); 'Twin Frames Double Price of Single Frame Plus $2.00.'; 'No Freight Allowance' is repeated for many hardware items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hardware pricing depends on lot size (case vs less-than-case); some items shipped direct from factory; catalogs often state 'No Freight Allowance' meaning freight not included. Twin frame pricing rule affects multi-frame orders.
